fields.name: model
fields.label: Model (dashboard Validate)
fields.description: Grid chat alias the dashboard binds so Validate passes. run.sh receives --model and ignores this value for scoring (Jev uses System One, not /v1/chat/completions). Set to any allowed chat model id on your key.

fields.name: model_alpha
fields.label: Model Alpha (evaluated)
fields.description: Required. System One model id sent to {base_url}/v1/systemone via --model-alpha. Example: jev-latest. This is the model JevBench scores.

fields.name: base_url
fields.label: Endpoint
fields.description: System One host (--base-url). Runner posts to {base_url}/v1/systemone; trailing /v1 or /v1/systemone is stripped.

fields.name: jev_version
fields.label: JevBench version
fields.description: Public release profile (--jev-version). v1.4.2.2 runs 231 public cases (easy + original + hard).

fields.name: task_range
fields.label: Task range
fields.description: Inclusive start-end on the 231-case list (--task-range). Smoke test: 0-9 (10 cases). Full run: leave empty. Indices: easy 0-47, original 48-119, hard 120-230. End past 230 is clamped.

fields.name: delay_s
fields.label: Delay between requests (seconds)
fields.description: Serial pause between cases (--delay-s). Default 0.5 helps stay under a 150 rpm key limit.

fields.name: split
fields.label: Split (informational)
fields.description: Ignored by run.sh. All runs use the full v1.4.2.2 public ordering; use task_range to slice that list.

fields.name: cap_usd
fields.label: Budget cap (USD)
fields.description: Ignored by run.sh (vendored harness uses its own ledger cap). Kept for dashboard parity with other evals.

fields.name: request_options
fields.label: Request options JSON
fields.description: Ignored by run.sh (System One adapter, not OpenAI chat completions).
